rules.floor: a successive difference d_k is on the float32 floor, and excluded, when d_k < 10 (R_k + R_k+1), R the max difference between the GPU run and its Float64 twin (same discrete update, same dt and grid); a true error e_k is excluded when e_k < 10 R_k
rules.orders: pairwise p_k = log(d_k/d_k+1)/log(step ratio) between accepted neighbors; fitted = least-squares slope of log2 d on log2 step over accepted points; observed = mean over seeds of the fitted order
rules.spread: halfRange = half the range of all accepted pairwise orders over the ladders of all seeds; seed.sd = standard deviation of the per-seed fitted orders
rules.norm: maximum absolute difference over all cells and species (rms recorded alongside)
rules.stability: largest dt at which no decaying eigenvalue of the one-step map of the (pi, pi) grid mode is amplified, the map linearized at the corners of the field envelope widened by 10% through the Float64 twin of the update on a 2 x 2 periodic lattice (dt < 2/|lambda| for a scalar forward Euler row)

cahn.integrator: forward Euler: mu = c^3 - c - eps^2 lap c from the old field, then c += dt M lap mu

clock.mutant: u_dt -> (2.0 * u_dt) in the step shader main(); run at dt/2 for 2n steps (recorded time T, field time 2T)

space.method: unit-cell stencils; spacing imposed by coefficient scaling; vertex-centered, injection; steps per level proportional to h^-4

mms.solution: u* = m + A (1 + beta t) phi(x, y), phi = three modes with |mx| + |my| <= 2 on a 16 x 16 periodic domain; continuum source S = u*_t - M lap mu(u*) added to the explicit update
mms.note: steps per level proportional to h^-4 (each level at the same fraction of its explicit bound), so the O(dt) time error is O(h^4) and the error is spatial

ohta.integrator: forward Euler: as cahn plus -sigma (c - m) in the same explicit update

amb.integrator: forward Euler: mu (with lambda |grad phi|^2) and lap phi from the old field, then phi += dt (M lap mu - zeta div J)

ceiling.rule: recipe v5 on (ceiling combined): min(1.6/R, 1.6/(Q D_n c^2), 0.5/m, 0.25) with R = Q D_w c^2 + 2 v c; recipes older than v5 (ceiling v4): the pre-v5 min(separate limits) where its step s satisfies s (R - 1) < 2, the combined ceiling elsewhere

instance.init: water 0.6 + 0.05 cos(2 pi x/N) + 1e-6 (-1)^(x+y), plants 0 (bare soil)
instance.criteria: decays: every later checkerboard amplitude below the initial one and the last below a tenth of it; grows: some later amplitude above ten times the initial one

ceiling: rule v4: step under 2/(R - 1), the pre-v5 step kept where it was stable and the combined step elsewhere
ceiling: no Fourier mode of the water row (bare soil) or the plant row amplified at the step taken
ceiling: the actual instance: the checkerboard decays at the module step under both rules
ceiling control: pre-v5 separate ceiling, clamp removed: the checkerboard grows wherever that step is past the bound, and decays where it is not
ceiling control: the computed bound brackets the actual shader: 0.98 of it decays, 1.02 of it grows
ceiling: every preset under the twin bound under both rules, and v4 reprints the pre-v5 step
